## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Failure-report matching should use the same path normalization as explicit selection so both selectors agree on which tests were requested.

## Changes

The pull request adds a failure-report selector that preserves the report’s path spelling, refactors cached selection, and adds tests for all three selectors.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- app/selection.py:20 — correctness — Normalize failure-report paths when matching — A report containing `./tests/test_x.py` returns an empty selection when the request contains `tests/test_x.py`. The selector compares the report path directly against `requested`. — When a report uses a `./` prefix, a rerun can skip the failed test the user requested. — Fix: Pass `report["failed"]` and `requested` to `select_explicit` to normalize comparisons while preserving the report paths in the result.
